text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano is due in Malaysia on Wednesday for a 72-hour state visit aimed at promoting economic, commercial, technical and cultural cooperation. He will also visit Pakistan to attend the Islamic Conference Organistion summit and Togo for an OAU meeting on conflict prevention and resolution.

- Mozambican President Joaquim Chissano has sacked two members of his government -- social welfare minister Alcinda Abreu and deputy minister for culture, youth and sport, Salomao Manhica. A statement from the presidency gave no reasons for the dismissals.
